notes.title: MAGIX Music Maker 2016 Live Updated
notes.content:
Important changes in version 22.0.3.63 compared to version 22.0.1.51

improved connection with Audio Remote App
Import from Music Maker Jam has been improved
Optimization of audio effects
Auto Mastering problems fixed
Live Pad mode improved
Dialog design changes
Reworked controlling Vita Instrument effects with external devices
Minor bug fixes
